decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. TXN-007914 is a 223.56 EUR purchase at Larkspur Apparel on card CRD-000178. It posted on 2026-09-30 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-26. That is 26 days, well inside the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The merchant's order confirmation (DOC-000020) gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-04. The dispute was opened 22 days after that, so the 15-day waiting period had passed (goods-not-received-wait). The carrier's delivery record (DOC-000021) shows the parcel was delivered on 2026-10-04 to the cardholder's address in Lille and signed for by V. Laurent. This matches the cardholder, Vera Laurent of Lille. Under goods-not-received-proof-of-delivery, a carrier record of delivery to the cardholder's address, signed in the cardholder's name, means the goods count as received, and the dispute is declined. No document contained an instruction to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: The carrier's record shows your Larkspur Apparel order was delivered to your address in Lille on 2026-10-04 and signed for by V. Laurent. Under our policy, the goods are therefore treated as received.
